components.name: Ink Tapered Button
components.description: Primary mono action with an asymmetrical directional wipe.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { background: var(--color-black-100, #1c1c1c); border: 0; border-radius: 4px; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 12px) 0, 100% calc(100% - 12px), calc(100% - 18px) 100%, 0 100%); color: var(--color-white-100, #fff); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-mono), monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; height: 40px; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 0 24px 0 20px; position: relative; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 220ms ease; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: var(--color-black-hover, #333); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--color-blue-100, #4a38f5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Tapered Button
components.description: Secondary action that stays flat until its directional hover response.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--color-black-100, #1c1c1c); border-radius: 4px; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 12px) 0, 100% calc(100% - 12px), calc(100% - 18px) 100%, 0 100%); color: var(--color-black-100, #1c1c1c); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-mono), monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; height: 40px; padding: 0 24px 0 20px; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 220ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(28, 28, 28, 0.05); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--color-blue-100, #4a38f5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Mono uppercase navigation item with blue active and hover state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; padding: 12px; } .ds-nav-link { color: var(--color-black-100, #1c1c1c); font-family: var(--font-mono), monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; position: relative; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link-active { color: var(--color-blue-100, #4a38f5); } .ds-nav-link-active::after { background: currentColor; bottom: -6px; content: ''; height: 2px; left: 40%; position: absolute; width: 20%; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--color-blue-100, #4a38f5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Editorial Card
components.description: Paper story container that earns its lift only on hover.
components.html:
CUSTOMER STORY

Designed to reveal the important work.

Editorial hierarchy and measured feedback do the structural work.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-white-100, #fff); border: 1px solid rgba(28, 28, 28, 0.1); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--color-black-100, #1c1c1c); padding: 20px 24px; transition: border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(28, 28, 28, 0.2); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-label { color: rgba(28, 28, 28, 0.6); display: block; font-family: var(--font-mono), monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin-bottom: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card h3 { font-family: var(--font-serif), serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.25; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-card p { color: rgba(28, 28, 28, 0.6); font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.55; margin: 0; }

components.name: Dark Select Field
components.description: Transparent select control for dark-form surfaces with blue focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-select { align-items: center; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.33); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--color-white-100, #fff); cursor: pointer; display: flex; font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 16px; height: clamp(40px, 5.5vh, 56px); justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 8px 0 12px; text-align: left; width: 100%; } .ds-select:hover { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); } .ds-select:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-blue-100, #4a38f5); outline: 1px solid var(--color-blue-100, #4a38f5); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Active Tag
components.description: Removable blue-tinted tag used to retain a selected value in a form field.
components.css: .ds-chip { align-items: center; background: rgba(74, 56, 245, 0.18); border-radius: 16px; color: var(--color-white-100, #fff); display: inline-flex; font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 14px; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; } .ds-chip-remove { background: transparent; border: 0; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; line-height: 1; padding: 0; } .ds-chip-remove:hover { color: var(--color-blue-70, #8174f8); } .ds-chip-remove:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blue-100, #4a38f5); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Twenty Website treats marketing as considered publishing with functional product mechanics. Paper and ink establish calm, readable hierarchy; a serif display face carries editorial conviction while a sans face explains and a mono face operates. The system is deliberately sparse, yet never passive: controls move with clear direction when a visitor expresses intent.

Surfaces stay flat and legible at rest. Borders do quiet structural work, then hover, focus, opening, and selection introduce only enough movement or lift to clarify a change of state. Accent color is signal, not decoration. The result should feel precise and founder-led rather than generic SaaS or corporate enterprise.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial type contrast over decorative chrome.
Ink, paper, and rare color signals.
Flat-at-rest surfaces with directional interaction feedback.

rules.name: The Rare Signal Rule
rules.body: Ink and paper carry ordinary hierarchy. Use a bright signal to express focus, selection, or an intentional product moment, never as ambient decoration across a screen.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use serif for conviction, sans for explanation, and mono for operation. Do not use weight alone to replace these roles.

rules.name: The Intent-Only Lift Rule
rules.body: Never pre-elevate ordinary surfaces. Add shadow or movement only when state, hierarchy, or interaction needs explaining.

dos: Do establish hierarchy through serif, sans, and mono roles before adding color or extra containers.
Do build rhythm from the 4px spacing unit and shift responsive composition at the implemented 921px and 1281px breakpoints.
Do use blue signal for focus, selection, and active navigation states.
Do keep controls and mobile hit areas at least 40px high or wide.
Do remove nonessential motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use bright accents as default page backgrounds or decorative wash.
Don't apply persistent card shadows; surfaces earn lift through intent.
Don't replace tapered primary actions with generic soft-pill buttons.
Don't use rounded, border-heavy containers to manufacture hierarchy that typography and spacing should establish.
